data.name: Fractured Halo
data.passiveDescription: After an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst is used, ATK is increased by {{24//30//36//42//48%}} for 20s. If the equipping character creates a Shield while this effect is active, they will gain the Electrifying Edict effect for 20s: All nearby party members deal {{40//50//60//70//80%}} more Lunar-Charged DMG.
